$description: Color roles of the ScheduLink marketing site. Components use these names, never palette steps. Brand roles and the blue illustration tints alias the generated brand ramp (ADR 0009); every other value is set by hand. Light only (ADR 0003).

surface.$description: Default page background. Most of the site sits on this.

surface-sunken.$description: Alternating section bands. Never two sunken bands in a row.

surface-raised.$description: Cards and panels. On light they need a line border to read, since there are no shadows.

surface-invert.$description: Reserved. The footer sits on the grey, not on a dark band (Seenu, 2026-10-27), so nothing on the site uses this yet.

ink.$description: The house dark. Headlines and primary text.

ink-muted.$description: Eyebrow labels, captions, metadata. Never body copy.

brand.$description: The ScheduLink blue, from the logo. Buttons, links, active states and the mark itself. Nothing decorative.

brand-strong.$description: Link text on light grounds and primary button hover.

brand-soft.$description: Tint behind a positive status chip or an active nav item. Text on it is brand-strong.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on brand fills.

attention.$description: Ground for anything that needs attention: a conflict flag, an overdue chip, a roster still outstanding. Neutral by design, with ink text and a 3px ink rule carrying the emphasis instead of a colour.

line.$description: Hairline borders, section rules, table dividers. Structure comes from these, not from shadows.

line-strong.$description: Input and control borders, secondary button outlines, focus rings.

page-grey.$description: The page ground. Sections float on it as white cards.

status-today-bg.$description: Due-today status pill background. Purple is used for due-today only.

illus-header-rule.$description: Line under column headers in product illustrations.

illus-placeholder.$description: Placeholder lines and pills in simplified rows.

illus-shootcard.$description: Shoot card background in the Photographers column.

illus-tile-line.$description: Border of the pale blue column-header tile in product illustrations. The tile itself is brand-soft.

illus-date.$description: Date tile and part tile fill in tab pictures.

illus-date-line.$description: Border of the date tile in tab pictures.

symbol-line.$description: Border of the white tile behind a benefit symbol.

confirm.$description: The green tick badge on a benefit symbol. Shapes only, always with a tick, never text.

grid-line.$description: Lines of the background grid behind homepage sections (Seenu, 2026-10-20).

grid-node.$description: Dots where background grid lines meet.

grid-mark.$description: Corner cross marks on section edges.
